Public single-cell and spatial datasets you can pull from for practice, reanalysis, and integration with your own work — grouped by the **generation technology** so you can find data that matches (or deliberately differs from) the 10x Chromium data the workshop uses.

## Atlases, portals & searchable repositories

Start here — these aggregate thousands of datasets across technologies and tissues.

-   **[10x Genomics datasets](https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets)** — the canonical source for Chromium (scRNA), scATAC, Multiome, Visium, and Xenium demo data, including the 20k NSCLC DTC set used in the [Full Talapas run from raw FASTQs](Resources_Folder/Talapas_FullRun_FromFASTQs.html).
-   **[CELLxGENE Discover](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/)** and the **[CZ CELLxGENE Census](https://chanzuckerberg.github.io/cellxgene-census/)** — curated, queryable, standardized atlases with built-in viewers and a programmatic API.
-   **[Human Cell Atlas Data Portal](https://data.humancellatlas.org/)** — the HCA's cross-tissue human reference data.
-   **[Tabula Sapiens (human)](https://tabula-sapiens-portal.ds.czbiohub.org/)** and **[Tabula Muris (mouse)](https://tabula-muris.ds.czbiohub.org/)** — multi-organ atlases with **both droplet and plate-based** assays of the same tissues (useful for technology comparisons).
-   **[GEO](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/)**, **[ArrayExpress / BioStudies](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/arrayexpress)**, and the **[Single Cell Portal (Broad)](https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell)** — searchable primary-data repositories.

## Droplet-based scRNA-seq (3′ / 5′)

High-throughput, shallow-per-cell — the family the workshop's `ifnb` (10x 3′ v1) belongs to.

-   **[10x Chromium datasets](https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets)** — PBMC 3k/10k, the standard teaching sets, plus 5′ and CITE-seq examples.
-   **Drop-seq** — Macosko *et al.* 2015 mouse retina, the original droplet method: GEO [GSE63472](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE63472).
-   **inDrops** — Klein *et al.* 2015 mouse embryonic stem cells: GEO [GSE65525](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE65525).

## Plate-based / full-length scRNA-seq (Smart-seq)

Lower throughput, deep per-cell coverage with **full-length** transcripts — good for isoforms and rare-cell detail.

-   **Smart-seq2** — the plate-based half of [Tabula Muris](https://tabula-muris.ds.czbiohub.org/) (run alongside its 10x droplet data on the same organs).
-   **Smart-seq3** — Hagemann-Jensen *et al.* 2020, full-length + UMI: ArrayExpress [E-MTAB-8735](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/arrayexpress/studies/E-MTAB-8735).

## Combinatorial-barcoding scRNA-seq (split-pool)

Instrument-free, very high throughput via successive rounds of barcoding (Parse Evercode, SPLiT-seq, sci-RNA-seq).

-   **SPLiT-seq** — Rosenberg *et al.* 2018 mouse brain & spinal cord: GEO [GSE110823](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE110823).
-   **sci-RNA-seq3** — the [Mouse Organogenesis Cell Atlas (MOCA)](https://atlas.gs.washington.edu/mouse-rna/), Cao *et al.* 2019 (~2 M cells).
-   **[Parse Biosciences Evercode datasets](https://www.parsebiosciences.com/datasets/)** — public split-pool whole-transcriptome data, incl. very large PBMC sets.

## scATAC-seq & multiome (chromatin accessibility)

The assay behind Modules 12 & 15 — open-chromatin (peaks/fragments) instead of transcripts.

-   **[10x scATAC & Multiome datasets](https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets)** — incl. the **PBMC 10k scATAC** set used in Module 15, and joint **RNA + ATAC** Multiome examples.
-   **sci-ATAC-seq** — the [Mouse sci-ATAC-seq Atlas](https://atlas.gs.washington.edu/mouse-atac/), Cusanovich *et al.* 2018 (~100k cells, 13 tissues).
-   **scATAC of human hematopoiesis** — Buenrostro *et al.* 2018: GEO [GSE96772](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE96772).

## Spatial transcriptomics

Expression with tissue coordinates — the family of Module 16's `stxBrain` (10x Visium).

-   **[10x Visium & Xenium datasets](https://www.10xgenomics.com/products/spatial-gene-expression/datasets)** — array-based (Visium) and high-plex imaging (Xenium) demo tissues.
-   **Slide-seqV2** — near-cellular-resolution beads, Stickels *et al.* 2021 (on the [Single Cell Portal](https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell)).
-   **MERFISH** — imaging-based, single-molecule: the [Vizgen mouse brain MERFISH datasets](https://info.vizgen.com/mouse-brain-map).
-   **Stereo-seq** — the [Mouse Organogenesis Spatiotemporal Transcriptomic Atlas (MOSTA)](https://db.cngb.org/stomics/mosta/), Chen *et al.* 2022.
